resource_gap: G026's metric is progress per wall per RESOURCE per intervention, and the resource term is NOT MEASURED. It is left null rather than substituted, because a throughput figure computed over three of four terms and reported as the metric is exactly the arithmetic G026 forbids. THE EXACT MISSING MECHANISM: campaign_memory_guard.sample() already reads free pages, compressor size, swapfile count and RSS, but nothing calls it at the START and END of an experiment and writes the delta into the receipt. Until a measured run brackets itself with two samples, resource is unknown and saying so is the honest reading.
note: a dispatched lane counts as a supervisor intervention: delegating the typing does not make the campaign autonomous, and counting lanes as free would let the ratio improve by fanning out harder
